faq.title: Everything About Patents & Trademarks in Uzbekistan
faq.subtitle: Official answers to the most frequent intellectual property questions:
faq.q1: How long does trademark registration take in Uzbekistan?
faq.a1: The standard examination procedure takes 6-7 months. An expedited 1-month fast-track registration procedure is also available upon payment of the designated state fee.
faq.q2: How are state fees calculated and are discounts available?
faq.a2: State fees depend on applicant status (Individual/Sole Trader vs Legal Entity) and the number of Nice classes. Individuals and Sole Traders receive a 50% official state fee discount. You can calculate the exact amount with our online calculator.
faq.q3: What happens if I don't register my brand?
faq.a3: Any competitor can legally register your brand name, block your operations, and sue you for damages up to 100M+ UZS.
faq.q4: Can PatentLex register trademarks abroad (USA, Europe, Russia)?
faq.a4: Yes, through the Madrid System and PCT treaties, we register trademarks and patents in over 130 countries worldwide directly from Tashkent.
faq.q5: What are Nice (MKTU) classes and how are they chosen?
faq.a5: The Nice Classification consists of 45 international classes of goods and services. For example, Class 43 is restaurants, Class 25 is apparel, Class 42 is IT services. Our experts determine the exact classes for your business.
faq.q6: How are copyrights for software, designs, or books protected?
faq.a6: Software source code, databases, design assets, and artistic works receive an official Ministry of Justice Copyright Certificate valid for the author's entire life plus 70 years.
